sections.hook: What happens when you trapezium rule $\int_a^b f(x)dx \approx \frac{h}{2}[f_0+f_n+2\sigma f_i]$? Let's explore applications of integration in IGCSE Add Maths.
sections.core_explanation:
Applications of Integration

Trapezium rule $\int_a^b f(x)dx \approx \frac{h}{2}[f_0+f_n+2\Sigma f_i]$ Overestimate vs underestimate Improving accuracy with more strips Connected rates of change $\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{dt}/\frac{dx}{dt}$ Solving $\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x)$ given a point Practical rate problems
